name: Prospect Drafts
tagline: Finds fitting prospects and leaves a ready first-touch email in your drafts.
description: Made for outbound sellers who would rather edit a note than write one from nothing. Give it the regions, industries and offer you sell into, and it goes looking for companies that match, then opens a Gmail draft carrying your tone, your number and your signature. Sending stays a human click.
author: sam_builds_ai
notes: Native Grok Bot share. Third-party bot; not from xAI.
